name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart, University of Notre Dame
architect: Fr. Alexis Granger, Fr. Edward Sorin and Br. Charles Harding
history: Father Edward Sorin of the Congregation of Holy Cross founded the University of Notre Dame in 1842 and first worshipped in a log chapel. After earlier churches outgrew their use, the present Gothic Revival church was begun in 1871 and consecrated on 15 August 1888. It is the mother church of the Congregation of Holy Cross in the United States.
arch: Brick and limestone Gothic Revival, with a bell tower 230 feet high, the tallest university chapel tower in America.
features: Its 44 large stained glass windows and its murals were completed over 17 years by Vatican painter Luigi Gregori.
More than 100,000 visitors come each year.

look.d: The tallest university chapel tower in America.
An early bell here was blown down with its tower in 1851; a 3,220-pound bell replaced it.

fun: In 1852 a local carpenter built the first church's twin spires in exchange for his son's tuition.
journal: A campus church with a Vatican painter's murals. The spire points past the Golden Dome.
